 Madurai District. ... Responde
 Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In
 praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to call f
 records pertaining to the impugned order passed by the 3rd respondent in
 Na.Ka.No.1330/A2/2024/U.Pa.Thu dated 08.07.2024 and quash the same

 consequently direct the 3rd respondent to remove the lock and seal of th
 petitioners shop namely Krishna Store situated at Main Road, Nattarmanga
 Village, Kalimangalam Post, Melur Taluk, Madurai District.
 For Petitioner : Mr.C.Ramesh
 For Respondents : Mr.Veerakathiravan  Additional Advocate General  assisted by Mr.K.Balasubramani  Special Government Pleader for R1 to R3  : Mr.A.Albert James  Government Advocate for R4  ORDER When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Advocate General assisted by the learned Special Government Pleader submitted that the petitioner has paid the fine amount and the premises has also been de-sealed. 
2. Recording the said development, the Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs. Consequently,
connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
